DIAGNOSIS READY: Contact Dermatitis (Allergic).

The chronic, pruritic, bilateral nature of the rash on the upper extremities, combined with the patient's history of exposure to potential allergens (implied by the "new substances" query context) and lack of response to spontaneous resolution, strongly points towards an allergic contact dermatitis.
